title: Fleet — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21).

items.title: Surface /fleet renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /fleet registered; FleetHomePage uses CompanyContext and renders FleetTablePage with operatingCompanyId; GET /api/v1/mdata/units?include=trailers resolves entity scope via resolveOperatingCompanyId + owner/leased predicate; FleetTable renders unit_number, VIN, type, status, location with no uuid-fallback labels; + Create Unit / + Create Trailer actions wired; honest empty state when no company selected; tests pass.

items.title: Surface /fleet/:id renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /fleet/:id registered as a ProtectedRoute wrapping FleetUnitLegacyRedirect; it redirects legacy unit bookmarks to canonical /fleet/units/:id and avoids collision with fleet leaf segments (/fleet/map, /fleet/transfers-in-progress, /fleet/units, /fleet/trailers); no dead end.

items.title: Surface /fleet/map renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: NOT YET VERIFIED. Surface enumerated from the route manifest on 2026-07-29. To reach PASS this route must be opened in the running app and shown to render real entity-scoped data (TRANSP and USMCA), every rendered field present in the submit payload where it writes, and forward/reverse linkage proven. No claim is made here beyond the route existing.
